description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to integration actions, including post actions, dialog handling, trigger ID generation and verification, and URL validation within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: PostAction
classes.description: Represents an interactive action in a post, supporting validation, equality check, and related properties.

classes.name: PostActionOptions
classes.description: Options for select-type actions, with validation.

classes.name: PostActionIntegration
classes.description: Contains URL and context for backend interaction upon action.

classes.name: PostActionIntegrationRequest
classes.description: Request structure for initiating an action, including user, channel, and context info.

classes.name: PostActionIntegrationResponse
classes.description: Response after processing an action, including updates and ephemeral text.

classes.name: PostActionAPIResponse
classes.description: Standard API response for post actions, including status and trigger ID.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a dialog window with elements, title, and configuration.

classes.name: DialogDateTimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration for date/time dialog elements, including timezone and manual entry options.

classes.name: DialogElement
classes.description: Defines individual dialog input elements with validation rules.

classes.name: OpenDialogRequest
classes.description: Request to open a dialog, including trigger ID, URL, and dialog data.

classes.name: SubmitDialogRequest
classes.description: Request to submit a dialog, including user, channel, and submission data.

classes.name: SubmitDialogResponse
classes.description: Response to dialog submission, with validation and form handling.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two PostAction objects.

methods.name: GenerateTriggerId
methods.description: Generates a signed trigger ID using a crypto.Signer.

methods.name: DecodeAndVerifyTriggerId
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a trigger ID, checking signature validity and expiration.

methods.name: DecodeAndVerifyTriggerId
methods.description: Method for OpenDialogRequest to decode and verify its trigger ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the entire dialog submission response.
